en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) street scene showing a row of traditional gabled townhouses lining a market square. Signs on the ground-floor shops read "Rudolph Wöhler" and "Gertrud Zschaler, Milch‑Kohl‑Meergem." A cyclist rides across the cobbled square and several women and children stand or sit in front of the shops. At the top left of the postcard, printed text reads "Grimma. Markt."
